messages:
alice: FYI found a small but breaking docs bug in /v1/embeddings API ref. OpenAPI and Node snippet use parameter name `inputs` (plural) but runtime accepts `input` (singular). Customers get 400: 'unknown field: inputs'.

rob: Oof. Which files?

alice: openapi.yaml -> components -> /v1/embeddings requestBody schema uses `inputs: string[]`. Node snippet in docs/snippets/node/embeds.js shows `inputs: ['text']`. Runtime expects `{ input: 'text' }` or batch `input: ['a','b']`? Need to confirm behavior and pick docs change.

tina: I repro'd locally: server accepts both singular `input` (string or array) and `inputs` gets dropped by strict schema validation. Runtime currently reads `input` only. Suggest updating docs to show `input` and mention batch usage. Also update OpenAPI example and Node/Python snippets.

rob: We'll prefer docs change to match runtime. Can you open a PR? Include a migration note: "If you used `inputs` change to `input`."

docs-bot: Created PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/723 by tina changes: openapi example -> use `input`, node snippet, python snippet, migration-note. CI: docs-lint passed.

alice: Customer confirmed they can change param name. Please also add a short unit test in docs CI that validates example payload against runtime schema to catch regressions.

tina: Good call. I'll add a lightweight JSON schema check in docs pipeline and a note in the PR. ETA: today.

rob: Once merged, let ops know in case any internal integrations used `inputs`.

docs-bot: PR merged to main: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/723. Staging docs updated.
